categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of accelerator-based Boron Neutron Capture Therapy (AB-BNCT) systems for cancer treatment. It also develops boron-containing therapeutic drugs (BPA) and diagnostic imaging agents (FBPA), provides radiation shielding planning services, and offers maintenance and repair services for AB-BNCT medical systems. The business spans precision chemical materials, medical devices, machinery manufacturing, and biotechnology services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The core technology centers on AB-BNCT, which integrates proton accelerators, neutron source target systems, neutron beam modulation, and patient positioning systems to generate high-intensity epithermal neutron beams for targeted cancer therapy. The company employs Monte Carlo simulation for radiation shielding design and develops boron-containing drugs and PET imaging agents under GMP standards. Manufacturing involves complex assembly of accelerator components, neutron beam systems, and sterile drug production via chemical synthesis and radiolabeling.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include specialized hospitals and medical centers that deploy AB-BNCT systems for cancer treatment. The company collaborates with top-tier Taiwanese hospitals such as China Medical University Hsinchu Hospital and Taipei Veterans General Hospital, and targets expansion into Asia-Pacific, North America, and Europe. End markets focus on oncology treatment centers requiring advanced radiotherapy technologies and associated pharmaceuticals.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered and operates its main manufacturing and R&D facilities in Hsinchu Science Park, Taiwan. It currently serves the Taiwanese market with plans to expand into the broader Asia-Pacific region including Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam, as well as North American and European markets through partnerships and clinical trials. The company also collaborates internationally with institutions in Japan and Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the BNCT supply chain, integrating upstream key components such as accelerators and neutron sources with downstream clinical application. It also vertically integrates by producing boron-containing drugs and diagnostic agents, providing a comprehensive BNCT solution from equipment manufacturing to pharmaceutical development and clinical support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous technological upgrades to enhance AB-BNCT system precision and stability, expanding clinical applications and indications, and developing new boron-containing drugs and diagnostic agents. The company emphasizes building maintenance and talent teams, global market expansion, and fostering collaborations with international medical institutions. R&D focuses on improving neutron production efficiency, miniaturizing equipment, and advancing personalized cancer therapies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales and installation of AB-BNCT medical equipment, provision of radiation shielding design services, and licensing or supply of boron-containing therapeutic and diagnostic drugs. The company also earns from maintenance and repair services for installed systems. Currently, revenues are limited due to the early commercial stage and ongoing clinical trials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the global leaders in AB-BNCT technology, competing with firms from Japan (Sumitomo Heavy Industries), South Korea, China, and the US. It differentiates itself with higher neutron production efficiency and lower operating power requirements. The BNCT market is highly concentrated with few players due to high technical barriers. The company’s vertical integration of equipment and drug production strengthens its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is in an early growth phase with no significant revenue from product sales yet, reporting operating losses due to heavy R&D investments. Total assets increased significantly due to capital raises and leasing clinical facilities. R&D expenses are substantial, reflecting ongoing clinical trials and product development. The company has sufficient cash reserves and plans further capital market activities to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a globally unique, fully integrated AB-BNCT solution combining advanced accelerator technology with proprietary boron-containing drugs and diagnostic agents. Its system achieves 4-5 times higher neutron production efficiency than competitors, enabling more precise and cost-effective cancer treatment with reduced radiation exposure. The vertical integration and strong clinical partnerships provide customers with a comprehensive, reliable, and innovative cancer therapy platform.
